brief:
Germany describes the humanitarian situation in Gaza as "catastrophic," according to Shehab Wire, calling for comprehensive improvements to aid supplies amid ongoing Israeli restrictions that obstruct relief organizations' work.

The German government stressed the necessity of enhancing humanitarian assistance deliveries to meet the needs of Gaza's population. Officials cited continuing Israeli constraints as a primary obstacle to the effective functioning of relief organizations operating in the territory.
